verdict.rationale: FireHydrant documents Runbooks as its automation engine, which runs workflow steps and actions according to specified conditions. Runbooks evaluate those conditions whenever an incident is declared. Documented actions include assigning roles, adding task lists, creating Slack channels, starting Zoom meetings and sending webhooks, and there is a documented Slack notification when a new AI summary is generated. missing for 10: explicit evidence of reminder steps and incident field-change actions, documentation of triggers on incident events beyond declaration (e.g., milestone or severity changes), independent or hands-on corroboration.
